query: 社区参与战略 社区参与战略 衡量企业与运营所在地社区进行沟通、资源共建、诉求反馈及长期投入的框架体系。重点考察社区议题识别的科学性、利益相关方参与深度及公益/共建项目的效果评估机制。 一、内容质量得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（卓越）：具备系统的社区参与战略（包含中长期目标）；定期开展社区需求调查（议题识别）；建立了双向、常态化的社区沟通与反馈机制；具备量化的社会影响力评估（如 SROI 评估或第三方成效审计）。 • 1分（合格）：有明确的公益或社区投入重点（如乡村振兴、教育支持），建立了基础的社区联系路径，有项目进展报告，但缺乏深度的需求调查、闭环反馈机制或系统的效果评估。 • 0分（不合格）：无相关政策或战略披露，或仅有零散、无计划的捐赠行为描述。 二、覆盖应用得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（高覆盖）：社区参与战略覆盖 >80% 的主要运营地区（如工厂所在地、核心门店网点）或重点公益预算项目。 • 1分（部分覆盖）：占比 >0% - 80%，或仅在总部所在地开展活动，而忽略了外地生产基地或分支机构的社区关系，或未说明覆盖比例。 • 0分（无覆盖）：无相关覆盖范围信息。 社区参与战略 社区需求调查 利益相关方沟通 社区投入 共建项目 社会投资回报 社区反馈机制 SROI community engagement strategy community needs assessment stakeholder dialogue community investment shared value SROI community feedback mechanism 是否有系统的社区参与战略、中长期目标或明确投入重点？ 是否定期开展社区需求调查或议题识别？ 双向沟通、诉求受理与反馈闭环是什么？ 有哪些共建/公益项目、投入金额及进展？ 是否开展SROI、第三方成效审计或其他量化社会影响评估？ 战略覆盖哪些主要运营地区、工厂所在地、门店网点或重点项目，覆盖比例是多少？

Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 是否有系统的社区参与战略、中长期目标或明确投入重点？ 是否定期开展社区需求调查或议题识别？ 双向沟通、诉求受理与反馈闭环是什么？ 有哪些共建/公益项目、投入金额及进展？ 是否开展SROI、第三方成效审计或其他量化社会影响评估？ 战略覆盖哪些主要运营地区、工厂所在地、门店网点或重点项目，覆盖比例是多少？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有零散无计划捐赠；仅有社会影响评估技术方法而无社区共建；仅有员工志愿服务时长无战略；仅有政府公关活动；区分：社区参与战略强调与运营地社区的沟通共建与长期投入；社会影响评估是项目社会后果识别缓释方法；实质性评估是ESG议题优先级，不是社区战略。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.text: The Group procures raw materials from the market for producing magnesium metal and magnesium alloys. The Group has developed corresponding inspection, assessment and selection procedures for raw materials suppliers. Upon receipt of bids from raw materials suppliers, the Group assesses comprehensively from the aspects of brand, quality, payment, schedule of delivery, reputation, and after-sales service, and seriously considering their energy and environmental policy to maximise environmental protection and minimise pollution. The most appropriate product supplier is determined based on a comprehensive score and ranking assessment by comparing individual suppliers. It ensures that premium-quality raw materials can be sourced at competitive prices, and the values of the selected supplier on environment, community and ethics are embraceable. All of the Group's suppliers are located in mainland China. There are about 10 major suppliers. During the Reporting Period, there were no material instances of non-compliance concerning the supply chain management.

The water consumption within the plants is mainly due to the water replenishment of the recirculating cooling system for the equipment and the domestic water consumption by our staffs. results.text: During the COVID-19 epidemic, the Group publicises the preventive actions of the COVID-19 epidemic through multiple channels, and educates employees to strengthen their awareness of preventive measures. The Group promotes the online-office mode, where business personnel uses phone calls and WeChat to carry out work. According to the requirements of the local governments where the production bases are located, the Group has reduced the number of visitors and workers walking across regions. Employees wear masks at all times during production and keep a safe social distance when eating and living. The Group has actively cooperated with relevant departments to organise regular COVID-19 testing and make sure employees are fully vaccinated to minimise the risk of virus transmission, and to ensure the health and safety of employees.
